summary: Banco Macro S.A. filed a 6-K furnishing its CNV notice that it acquired 410,355 Class B common shares (Ps$1 par, one vote each) in the market at an average Ps$10,059.904 per share, for an aggregate Ps$4,128,131,910, under Section 64 of Argentine Law 26,831 and CNV rules (the local equivalent of a US issuer buyback). No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or fixed completion date is stated; authorization is the general shareholders' mandate. Watch ongoing daily repurchase disclosures, buyback pace versus the mandated cap, and any cancellation versus treasury-share treatment affecting float and EPS.
